nights.title: Joker Out
nights.name: Joker Out
nights.extract: Joker Out is a Slovenian indie rock band formed in Ljubljana in 2016. They represented Slovenia in the Eurovision Song Contest 2023 with the song "Carpe Diem", placing 21st. Their discography includes three studio albums: Umazane misli (2021), Demoni (2022), and Souvenir Pop (2024).
